LM16-01.name: The FiftyFirstBeast Revol-Koleon
LM16-01.effect:
Main- [Accel: Cost 4 ([Red Core][Red Core])]
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Imagine" family Brave card and a "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any reemaining cards. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned from the Removed Zone, you can summon an "Imagine" family Brave card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

LM16-04.name: Battle Spirits Burning Soul (Card)
LM16-04.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your Spirit with Soul Core on it attacks, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Spirits with Soul Core on it gain an extra Red Symbol.

LM16-05.name: Battle Spirits Double Drive (Card)
LM16-05.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit is summoned, draw a card. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[During Seal] [LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced, for each reduced Life, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

LM16-09.name: Fire & Wind
LM16-09.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Or, exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate.

LM16-06.name: It's New Year's! Battle Spirits
LM16-06.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give all your Brave Spirits: "Purple/Blue This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects."

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh a Brave Spirit you control.

LM16-07.name: Mogami Family's Day Off
LM16-07.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
If your Life is at five or less, put a core from the Void each to your Reserve and the opposing Reserve.

[LV2]
Give all your Spirits +2000 BP.

LM16-08.name: Professor Battleskii's BS Course!
LM16-08.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
During this turn, treat a Spirit you control as being on its highest LV.

[LV2]
When your Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, put a core from the Void to your Reserve.
